results.title: Switch Your Magic Trackpad Between Macs Without Re-Pairing — LinkFlick
results.content: May 13, 2026 - Your trackpad is ready on the other Mac in about 10 seconds. LinkFlick supports the Magic Trackpad (1st gen), Magic Trackpad 2, and Magic Trackpad 3. All enter Bluetooth discovery mode automatically after unpairing, which is what allows LinkFlick to perform a silent re-pair on the destination Mac — no PIN codes, no confirmation dialogs.
